### L1 review — #35082 (Part of #35018, PR 1: Studio items 1–3) · 2026-11-18T02:02Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: adeba0162cf642a80d8cf9489d20a48dcc294074

**Surface.** All 18 files are inside claim 6964950830 (PR 1 slice) plus amendment 6966717997:
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` and `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` are named in the claim. `DataPillar`, `AccessPillar` and `AutomationsPillar` live in that file, so the `DataPillar.*` tests are that file's existing tests.
- `StudioRightSlot.tsx` and the studio `en.ts` / `zh.ts` come from the amendment. Those are the only studio locale files, so no other language is left stale.
- Every edited test belongs to an in-surface file, and there is a root changeset.
- `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` and `StudioAiCopilot.tsx` are unchanged, which the claim allows.
- I confirm NOT governed (`check-governed-merges --branch`): 0 of 18 paths hit the register, 416 changed lines.

**Item 1, permission page.**
- `studioTitle` is now `headerLabel || name`. `PermissionStudioChrome.appLabel` and `AccessPillar.packageLabel` are removed along with their one caller.
- The note reads `engine.studio.access.origin.app` (随应用提供 / "Included with the app"). Setup keeps `perm.badge.package`, so only the Studio site changes.
- The banner, the pair banner and the three hover texts say 应用 / app instead of 包 / package, and no longer name a 「Save」 button.
- 发布后生效 matches what the hover already said (saved as a draft, live on Publish).
- #34795's title pin is rewritten to an exact `textContent === '组织成员'` plus a no-app-name scan of the header. That reversal is the card's own acceptance line ("权限页标题里应用名只出现一次（顶栏）").

**Item 2, 正在看.** Access and Automations now report through `onSurfaceLabelChange`, the seam Data and Interfaces already use. Both use the ref-held callback keyed on primitives, and both clear on unmount. The labels:
- the flow's label prefers `useFlowLabelTranslations`, the same label the canvas header reads;
- the record-visibility overview reports its own title.

`type` and `name` still travel as before, so the hover title and the agent's `context.surface` are unchanged. Interfaces already used labels on main and has an existing pin.

**Item 3, field panel.**
- The Data field rail mounts the inspector under `InspectorShellHostProvider`, the objectui#12488 seam the Automations config rail already uses. `InspectorShell` then draws no header of its own, and its actions portal into the aside's header slot.
- The aside's title is the field label. The `id` (machine name) shows only when the rail is not hosted, which covers groups and the no-inspector fallback.
- The host's `onSelectionChange` is `setFieldSel`. Only `FlowObjectListField` reads it today, so nothing calls it with the field inspector's selection shape.
- The live reading shows one close button inside the panel, `meeting_name` hidden until 开发者信息, and no foot strip. The slot's own X is the slot collapse, a separate control.

**On the scope of the strip removal, which the requester asked me to weigh: I accept it as slot-wide.**
- The strip is one element of the shared `StudioRightSlot` chrome, not part of any rail's property panel. The card offers removing it as one of its two options, and its stated reason holds on every rail: the header's 属性 | AI 助手 switch does the same thing and carries the same 「N 项待确认」 count.
- Keeping the strip only on Automations and Interfaces would need a per-rail flag. It would also make the same slot behave two ways.
- #34796's exclusion covers those rails' property panels, and they are untouched. The `studio-slot-copilot-strip` absence is pinned in the rightSlot, pillarsClaimSlot, leafColumn and kanban tests.
- `engine.studio.slot.backToChat` is still used by the history toggle's aria-label, so no locale key is orphaned.

**Pins and ablations.** The pins are `accessWording-34795` (exact title, no 包内置 / 本包), a new `aiChipLabel` describe (real surface, dock and ChatPane; the chip text plus the unchanged title and agent surface), and `readOnlyRailReason-12303` (real `ObjectFieldInspector`: exactly 1 Close, a hosted shell, the machine name visible only after 开发者信息, as the CONTROL). Ablations ran at 992a138c and went 1, 1 and 2 red, each restored. The only later commit, adeba016, changes locale values and the changeset.

**Live (zh-CN 1280, self-built app, before and after)** in `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat3/35018-live/a/`. I read the after shots and log:
- the title is 「组织成员」 and its note 「随应用提供 · 新用户默认」;
- the tab note is 「本应用对象 · 发布后生效」 and is not cut with the AI panel open;
- the chips read 「正在看：权限 · 组织成员」 and 「正在看：流程 · 新会议提醒」;
- the field panel has one header (字段属性 · 会议名称 · actions · ×) and no strip.

**Clause-②: no** and **Metadata-protocol: none** are correct: this is display wording and chrome only.

Must-fix: none.
Should-fix: none.

Notes:
- The out-of-scope observation is that an Interfaces leaf created without a label gets `label = name`, so its chip would show the machine name. It is noted and not filed. It is a creation-path default, not this card's chip seam.
- CI at review time: 13 success, 13 skipped, 29 in progress. Landing waits on all checks being green.

Landing: ordinary queue landing (not Tier H) via the seat. PR 2 (item 4, landing, `Closes #35018`) follows from fresh main.
